notes: Closed beta build (2026-10-26). Studio now tells you when a newer installer is out: a banner under the menu bar says "Campfire Studio X.Y.Z is out" with Download (opens the download page in your browser) and Later. It checks once, about a minute and a half after launch, never while you are live, and never downloads or installs anything by itself. The installer closes a running Studio before installing over it, and keeps your settings, scenes and stats. The beta installer is not code-signed yet: Windows SmartScreen will warn on first run ("More info" ▸ "Run anyway").
